_note: The app-visual toolchain, pinned (docs/design/app-visuals.md). `pbik tools install` downloads each item into the kit tools folder (%USERPROFILE%\.pbik-tools, or PBIK_TOOLS; not AppData: Store apps see a redirected copy of it), checks its sha256 against this file and refuses a mismatch. npm packages are pinned by package.json and package-lock.json beside this file. Nothing here is ever copied into the repo. To update an item: change it here, run `pbik tools install`, then /smoke.

playwright.browsersPath: %LOCALAPPDATA%\ms-playwright when it already has this Chromium, else <tools>\ms-playwright
playwright.use: reuses the Chromium build already in the browsers folder when it is the one this version needs
